ideas.title: Investigating Daycare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the allegations of daycare fraud in Minnesota and the suspension of funding by the USDA.
questions: What is the extent of the daycare fraud in Minnesota?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a significant issue with daycare fraud in Minnesota and to hold those responsible accountable.

ideas.title: The ICE Shooting in Minneapolis: What Happened?
ideas.description: An investigation into the fatal shooting of a woman by an ICE agent in Minneapolis.
questions: Was the use of force justified?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to provide a detailed account of the events leading up to the shooting and to examine the use of force by the ICE agent.
